title: Truthful UI and Observed Historical Low Semantics
context: Ensuring truthful claims when displaying historical lows and discount authenticity.
decision: Label historical low prices as 'Takip başladığından beri görülen en düşük fiyat' and track separate confidence levels based on tracking duration. No synthetic mock data.
alternatives: Using mock historical lows for early launch
consequences: Protects users from deceptive marketing claims
Builds high trust with accurate data provenance labels
Explicit confidence scores clarify the depth of historical data
risks: Users might initially see identical current and lowest price for freshly tracked games. Clear UI explanation required.
